Configuration breakdown

Settings and recommendations
How this estimate works

This is a transparent rule-based review, not AI or a benchmark. It checks installed RAM, output resolution, texture quality, MSAA, shadows, low-memory mode, and texture cache. Device names and RAM values inside the uploaded file do not replace your saved device.

Review policy v1: below 4 GB RAM adds 6 points; 4 GB adds 3; 6 GB adds 1. Above 540p adds 1 point, above 720p adds 2, and above 1080p adds 3. Texture quality adds its numeric level (0–2). MSAA adds 2 when enabled. Shadow quality above 1 adds 1. Disabling low-memory mode on devices with 4 GB or less adds 2. A texture cache above 10% of installed RAM adds 2.

Fair: 0–2 points. Serious: 3–5. Critical: 6 or more. These thresholds are site review rules, not measured thermal states or verified performance limits. Fair does not guarantee smooth gameplay. Unknown hardware or missing/unsupported values produce “Not assessed”. Shader effects, streaming budgets, frame caps, signing entitlements, and thermal conditions are not scored.

Installed RAM is not the memory available to the game. iOS limits, signing entitlements, temperature, graphics settings, and the port version can affect results. This page does not measure FPS or certify compatibility.

Sources and assessment method

Chip details come from Apple. RAM uses hardware teardowns or original analysis of Apple’s Xcode files. Unknown values stay unverified. This checker uses a site-level planning profile of 6 GB RAM, iOS 16 or later, and approximately 30 GB free storage. These are not verified release minimums. Follow the current release notes in our Discord server.
